name: PAPA MURPHYS TAKE N BAKE PIZZA

violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Observed food employee change gloves, but did not wash his hands before putting on new pair. Hands should be washed before putting on gloves.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Pizza prep area was found dirty. Prep area should be cleaned and maintained clean.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Fan blade covers were found dirty. These should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in a clean, dry manner to protect from contamination. Clean utensils and lids were found stored in dirty bins. Clean equipment should be stored in a clean location.

Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. Faucet connection was found leaking at the prep sink. Plumbing should be properly maintained.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Flooring in the storage area, near the back door, was found broken. Floor should be properly maintained.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Blade for the can opener was found dirty during inspection. Blade should be cleaned and maintained clean.
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Handwashing, good hygienic practices (5 pts deducted)
